pipeline:
# GitHub Actions CI pipeline for unit/component tests
# Generated by BMad TEA Agent - Test Architect Module
# Stack: frontend | Framework: Node built-in test runner (node --test)
#
# Test command is the project's own `npm test` (node --test tests/*.test.cjs).
# No browser suite exists, so there is no browser install, sharding or UI burn-in.
# The project declares no dependencies and has no lockfile, so there is no install step
# and no dependency cache; add `npm ci` and `cache: npm` once a package-lock.json exists.

name: Test Pipeline

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  # Test stage - unit/component tests via the project's npm test script
  test:
    name: Test (Node ${{ matrix.node }})
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15

    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        node: [24]

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node }}

      # The gate must be able to fail: no continue-on-error on the test step.
      # NODE_OPTIONS adds a JUnit report next to the console output; npm test is unchanged.
      - name: Run tests
        env:
          NODE_OPTIONS: --test-reporter=spec --test-reporter-destination=stdout --test-reporter=junit --test-reporter-destination=test-results/junit.xml
        run: |
          mkdir -p test-results
          npm test

      # Fail when a discovered test file did not run, so a suite cannot quietly shrink.
      - name: Reconcile discovered and executed test files
        run: |
          missing=0
          for f in tests/*.test.cjs; do
            if ! grep -q "file=\"[^\"]*/$f\"" test-results/junit.xml; then
              echo "::error::$f was discovered but did not report in junit.xml"
              missing=1
            fi
          done
          exit "$missing"

      - name: Upload test results
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: test-results-node-${{ matrix.node }}
          path: test-results/
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 30

  # Report stage - summarize results
  report:
    name: Test Report
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: test
    if: always()

    steps:
      - name: Generate summary
        env:
          TEST_RESULT: ${{ needs.test.result }}
        run: |
          {
            echo "## Test Execution Summary"
            echo ""
            echo "- **Status**: $TEST_RESULT"
            echo "- **Suite**: node --test (unit/component)"
          } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          [ "$TEST_RESULT" = "success" ]
